external_proof_scope: This inventory checks applications to the stated exact source versions. It does not re-prove external papers. In particular the accepted Frei–Tinková preprint proof remains an external input.

new_source_qualifications.text: The published 2021 Proposition 14.6.7 was inspected directly, but the local download did not yield a PDF. No byte hash of the published chapter is claimed; the old corrected-book hash is a distinct version.

The Frei–Tinková theorem is checked against arXiv:2408.17441v3, accepted/to appear in Mathematika as reported by the author. No final published text was verified. The proof is therefore not described as using exclusively final published theorem versions.
The present 1272-coordinate coefficient table is independently reconstructed. It is not identified with the unavailable Brox 1315-coordinate gate/table artifact.

Browning–Loughran and Browning–Heath-Brown are verified published works. Exact theorem checks used the pinned accepted manuscripts and compared preprints; inaccessible final typeset text was not compared.

Dodos–Kanellopoulos is a verified published work. The exact Theorem 5.1 was inspected in arXiv:1610.00487v4, after publication; the final typeset statement was not compared. The appendix repairs the majorant norm exponent in the imported Frei–Tinková proof route. That local repair does not independently close all of the preprint’s new analytic proof steps.
